changelog:
Initial release of Learn Anything in One Hour skill.

- Guides users to learn any new skill in about 60 minutes using an optimized 4-step process for beginners.
- Focuses on teaching the essential 20% of concepts that deliver 80% of real-world value.
- Includes hands-on demo, a clear error cheat sheet, and practical next steps for advanced learning.
- Activates when users request a fast, beginner-friendly crash course in a new skill or topic.
- Designed for users with zero prior knowledge.
